compressor.title: Image Compression Tool
compressor.intro: Image compression tool supporting JPG, PNG, WebP and more, with customizable quality, size and format, batch compression while preserving quality

compressor.uploadHint: Supports JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP formats (multi-select supported, up to 20 images)
compressor.optionDefault: Default compression (balanced quality and size, preserves original image format)
compressor.optionLossless: Lossless compression (highest quality, preserves original extension, ideal for PNG with transparency)
compressor.optionAggressive: Aggressive compression (prioritizes smaller file size, converts to JPG)
compressor.optionWebp: WebP format (efficient modern browser format, keeps file size small)
compressor.algorithmTip:
There is no single best compression algorithm - only the strategy that best fits your needs. Different algorithms suit different scenarios:
- Default compression: Balances quality and size while preserving the original image format. Not suitable for transparent PNG images. Recommended for: regular JPG images and non-transparent images that must keep their original format
- Lossless compression: Preserves the highest quality and original extension. Not recommended for JPG images, as it may enlarge files or fail to compress effectively. Recommended for: transparent PNG images and images requiring full detail retention
- Aggressive compression: Prioritizes smaller file size and converts everything to JPG for the best compression ratio, noticeably reducing image quality. Recommended for: minimizing file size when image quality is not a priority
- WebP format: An efficient modern browser image format that significantly reduces file size while keeping high quality. Recommended for: website images, WebP-supported apps, and when seeking a balance of high quality and small size
compressor.qualityTip: The higher the compression quality, the better the image quality but the larger the file size; the lower the value, the higher the compression ratio but image details may be lost. A setting between 70-90 is recommended; adjust according to your actual needs.
compressor.dimensionTip: Tip: Max dimension limits the upper bound of the image (100-16384px); max file size limits the size of the compressed file, ranging from 20KB up to the original file size - you can enter any value within this range.

stitch.usageSelect2: Select All / Clear: Use the "Select All" or "Clear" buttons for batch operations.
stitch.usageSelect3: View List: Selected images are shown in the stitch order list.
stitch.usageOrder1: Drag to Sort: Drag images in the stitch order list to adjust their order.
stitch.usageOrder2: Reverse Order: Click the "Reverse Order" button to quickly reverse it.
stitch.usageOrder3: Order Matters: The stitch order determines the arrangement of the final image.
stitch.usageSettings1: Stitch Direction: Choose vertical stitching (stacked) or horizontal stitching (side by side).
stitch.usageSettings2: Gap: Adjust the spacing between images (0-50 pixels).
stitch.usageSettings3: Background Color: Choose the background color of the stitched result.
stitch.usageSettings4: Maintain Aspect Ratio: Keeps the original aspect ratio when checked.
stitch.usageSettings5: Unify Size: Resizes all images to the same dimensions when checked.
stitch.usageStitch1: Click to Stitch: Click the "Start Stitching" button to stitch the images.
stitch.usageStitch2: Real-time Preview: The result is displayed in the preview area after stitching.
stitch.usageStitch3: Double-click to Zoom: Double-click the preview to view it in fullscreen.
stitch.usageStitch4: Add to List: Click "Add to List" to add the stitched result to the pending list for further re-stitching.
stitch.usageStitch5: Download Image: Click the "Download Image" button to save the stitched result.
stitch.usageStitch6: Stitch Again: After adding the stitched result to the list, you can stitch it with other images.
stitch.usageStitch7: Flexible Combination: Supports multiple stitching rounds to create complex layouts.
stitch.noteSecurity1: All processing is done entirely in your local browser; data is never uploaded to any server.
stitch.noteSecurity2: Image files are processed only in browser memory and are automatically cleared when finished.
stitch.noteSecurity3: We recommend using private browsing mode when processing sensitive images.
stitch.noteSettings1: At least 2 images are required to stitch.
stitch.noteSettings2: When maintaining the aspect ratio, images may have blank areas.
stitch.noteSettings3: When unifying size, images are proportionally scaled to the same dimensions.
stitch.noteSettings4: A large gap increases the final image size.
stitch.noteFormat1: Transparent PNG images remain transparent after stitching.
stitch.noteFormat2: Images in different formats can be stitched together.
stitch.noteFormat3: Only the first frame of a GIF image is processed.
stitch.notePerf1: Stitching large images takes time; please be patient.
stitch.notePerf2: We recommend compressing images before stitching to improve processing speed.
stitch.notePerf3: Do not close the browser or refresh the page during processing.
stitch.noteFaq1: Stitching Failed: Check that at least 2 images are selected.
stitch.noteFaq2: Image Overlap: Check the stitch direction and gap settings.
stitch.noteFaq3: Download Failed: Check your browser download permission settings.
stitch.noteFaq4: Re-stitching Issue: Make sure the stitched result has been added to the list.
